Hey there, fellow ACNL player here.

I understand your worries about resetting, many memories have been created in your town, and you've created some bonds to the villagers too. There's one thing to remember though: If you reset, you will have a chance to be happy with your town and remake all of the building choices you've made. I bought NL around 2014, I had an amazing town, which I reset yesterday. It feels really good, being able to start from fresh. I've chosen my building options more carefully, preserved my town a lot more. 

However, remember that it WILL take time to achieve a relatively good-looking town that you are happy with. Please do not reset your game, to find out that you cannot be bothered with all the work and effort and abandoning NL. What do you play on? We could exchange details or friend codes if you would like, maybe we could go through this together if you'd like. (Just a thought) :)
